stages.qualification: Owner reported entering API input, consent and clicking check/save; values and click timestamp were not observed.
Remaining scoped tab carries valid non-authorizing install locator and uncertain notice. Raw locator, fields, auth and request body were not read.
Historical child stdout/stderr ignored and no per-request safe trace existed. No status is reconstructed from absence of an AE row.

Source guard admits provider fetch only in explicit authenticated connect/activate POST scope. Aggregate dispatch supports that such a scope ran, but is not an owner-request correlation or an AE policy receipt.
Provider HTTP status, payload success, per-call time and browser-request correlation were not retained. Zero guard refusals does not mean provider success.
Same owned DB/system and exact previously confirmed owner tenant. Only safe metadata selected; install/activate/import/disconnect executions checked.
No precise submit/provider reply time relative to expiry is available.

observerCorrection: The historical observer required exact initial href and also rejects URLs with a valid pending-operation query. Thus outside_scoped_page is not proof of navigation or tab closure. The cause of the specific historical marker was not independently observed.
interpretation: Source preview runs before AE admission; a pre-admission failure can leave NOT_OBSERVED. This is a possible mechanism, not a proven cause of the owner attempt.
